description: §19.16.3 rule 3 — a failable call in a deferred body must be handled in place. `defer closeAll()` (closeAll is `!`) is E-DEFER-UNHANDLED-FAILABLE even though the enclosing function is itself `!` — and the generic E-ERROR-002 does NOT also fire for the same call.
rationale: §19.16.3 rule 3: `?` is excluded and an enclosing `!` does not satisfy the requirement (the block is already exiting); inside a deferred body this code REPLACES E-ERROR-002 for the same call.
